newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine leasing, financing said growing fast.
newsitem.headline: Philippine leasing, financing said growing fast.

text.p: The leasing and financing sector posted a remarkable growth in 1995 with loans of 26.9 billion pesos in 1995, up 48.6 percent from the 1994 level, a study by PCI Leasing said on Wednesday.
PCI is a unit of PCIBank.

PCI Leasing said the industry can achieve a yearly average growth rate of 15 percent this year up to 1998 in terms of total portfolio, with the growth fueled by three major businesses: manufacturing, construction and utility.
It added the growth of the leasing and financing business could also be largely attributed to the rapidly expanding small and midsized enterprises which include start-up ventures in the countryside.

The leasing and financing industry is expected to be further boosted by proposed bills relaxing foreign ownership following the opening of the banking industry to foreign banks in 1995, PCI Leasing said.
